g.text: Rows are targets and columns are predictors; only production-active links are shown. DO_1_4 is excluded as a predictor, and DO_2_2 to DO_2_4 was rejected in Fig. 11.
Validation depth: DO_2_4 uses the full forward/hold-out/injection audit; other targets use topology-constrained three-fold blocked CV. p = peer count; k = retained components.
Supplementary Figure S1. Formal PLS peer topology used in D1 drift scoring
